page_title: Sitely, the website builder that belongs on iPad

summary.name: Sitely
summary.one_liner: Sitely is a visual website builder for iPad and Mac, aimed at non-coders, with AI assistance and Apple Pencil support.
use_cases: designing a personal or business website without coding
sketching and annotating website layouts with Apple Pencil
building a site with payments, bookings, or a blog
editing a website on iPad and Mac synced through iCloud
summary.what_it_does: Sitely is a visual website design and publishing app for iPad and Mac, described as jargon-free and aimed at people who do not code. Users can move elements freely rather than being limited to templates. Apple Pencil support lets users write, sketch, and annotate directly on the layout. The page says sites are kept in iCloud and can be opened on either Mac or iPad. It lists features including payments and bookings, blogs, advanced animations, AI-built widgets, and 3D models, and a Website Assistant intended to help with Google visibility. Sites are said to be published in one tap and load without loading screens.
notable: Apple Pencil support for sketching and annotating layouts
Sites sync via iCloud between Mac and iPad
Free-form element placement instead of templates-only
AI-built widgets and a Website Assistant for search visibility
caveats: Requires iPadOS 18 or macOS 10.14 at minimum
Pricing is not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing copy; feature claims are not independently detailed
